exposure: body temperature change from postbirth resuscitation (Tr) to admission (Ta)
transition from Tr hypothermia to Ta normothermia/hyperthermia
cohort: The study included inborn infants less than 33 weeks gestational age, born between January 1, 2017, and May 31, 2021.
finding: Hypothermia during the neonatal body temperature transition from resuscitation to admission was associated with an increased risk of prematurity-related complications, including periventricular leukomalacia, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, and death before discharge.
